answer.rationale: The 94% committed-volume load makes an unvalidated primary-source migration a material delivery-risk increase, even though the low-cost quote meets the spend mandate. I will verify incumbent continuity evidence and the low-cost vendor's original onboarding/performance record, then use the competitive quote to negotiate an incumbent renewal that targets the 18% reduction while preserving proven integration and delivery continuity. If the incumbent cannot meet the required economics, the switch decision remains contingent on verified delivery capability.
